Title: Can player who skip round enter in finals?

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Can player who skip round enter in finals in VTES tournament?
First to say if I put topic in wrong place please admins move on right place.
I will ask about 3 scenario where player dint play every game if posible to enter to finals.

1) player dint play round 1,him enter in competion in round 2,if legal to him play finals?

2) if player play round 1,and then must emergency leave and dint play round round 2 (in format 2R+F) and him back before finals start,can him play in finals?

3) if player play round 1,and then must emergency leave and dint play round round 2 (in format 3R+F) and him back in round 3,can him continue play round 3 and finals?

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: Why not? The tournament rules do not cover skipping a round but you can just use late arrival rules. Allowing a player to come back is at the judge's discretion, but once he is accepted there is no reason to ban him from the finals if he can qualify.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> 1) player dint play round 1,him enter in competion in round 2,if legal to him play finals?
>
Yes (at the judge's discretion), this is covered by 3.3.1 Late Arrivals.

> beslin wrote:
> 2) if player play round 1,and then must emergency leave and dint play round round 2 (in format 2R+F) and him back before finals start,can him play in finals?
>
This is not covered by the tournament rules. Personally, I would disallow it as it could create some unfair distribution of the VP* (for instance, the player plays on the only 5-players table, scores a GW, then leave for 1 round, resulting in 4-players tables). If the player has a real emergency, it's better for everyone if they drop the tournament.
Furthermore, if the player doesn't know when they'll come back, the organization is disrupted as no one knows how long that player must be waited for, and most players have better things to do than waiting for someone.
If the player comes back during the 2nd round, who knows if they'll be able to play the final, so maybe they came back from their emergency for nothing.

> beslin wrote:
> 3) if player play round 1,and then must emergency leave and dint play round round 2 (in format 3R+F) and him back in round 3,can him continue play round 3 and finals?
>
Same as above: it disrupts the distribution of the VP*, it disrupts the organization, and if it's an emergency, then playing a tournament is probably not the most important thing to do.

*it also happens with late arrival, but the player has no knowledge of how good they'll perform during the tournament, and it also happens with early leave, but you can't force someone to play.

Prince of Paris, France
